text:
maya (PM): Heads-up — we got a few converging customer asks this week that touch SDKs/integrations. Can we triage here?

jordan (Support): Customer A (healthcare) needs SSO + SCIM for Private deploy. They're stuck on onboarding.

sophia (Sales): + Customer B (fintech) pushed for a Terraform provider to codify Dedicated capacity and model pinning. They said it's a blocker for contract signing.

priya (DevEx): We also have a handful of small asks: Python streaming client improvements, JS typings, and a marketplace listing request from a partner.

alex (Eng): Thanks — quick sanity check: are we treating SSO/SCIM as security/compliance work (Private) vs Terraform as infra automation (Dedicated)? Might need separate owners.

maya (PM): Yes. My gut: SSO/SCIM = enterprise compliance lane (P0 for healthcare customer), Terraform provider = high biz impact (P1 for fintech), SDK improvements = P2 backlog grooming.

jordan (Support): Healthcare customer reported they can't federate users today; they need SCIM delta sync + SCIM tokens. They asked for timeline.

priya (DevEx): For tagging/triage, propose we use these backlog labels: 
```
labels: ["customer-request","integration","area:devex","priority:P0/P1" ]
```
Also create a triage ticket template in Zendesk so we capture the required fields.

alex (Eng): Proposed engineering scope for SSO/SCIM: SCIM server endpoints + delta sync + audit logs + KMS integration for tokens. Estimate: 3 devs x 6 weeks (includes security review).

maya (PM): For Terraform provider: implement resources for redwood_dedicated_pool, redwood_model_pin, provider auth flow. Minimal viable provider could be one sprint (2 weeks) if we limit initial scope (no complex autoscale features).

priya (DevEx): Marketplace listing has checklist: integration guide, terraform examples, quickstart templates for Py/JS. We can reuse parts of the provider docs.

sophia (Sales): If we can commit the provider MVP in 2–3 weeks for B, they will sign. Can we fast-track?

alex (Eng): We can attempt a focused sprint but need exact acceptance criteria and an owner. I'm okay to allocate a small squad if PM + Sales commit to scope lock.

maya (PM): Action items:
- priya: create triage ticket in Zendesk and add labels: customer-request, integration, area:devex, priority:P0 for healthcare ticket. (due EOD)
- alex: draft rough engineering spec for SSO/SCIM and Terraform provider (due 48h)
- sophia: push timeline to Customer B and flag contract pause if timeline slips
- jordan: attach customer logs/SSO configs to tickets

priya (DevEx): I'll add the marketplace checklist and example snippets to the ticket. Example snippet for backlog tag we want on GH issues: `integration/sdk terraform marketplace customer-request`

alex (Eng): Spec note: SCIM delta sync needs to support per-tenant rate limits and replay-safe tokens. We'll need a small design review with security. @ci-bot please create a security-review checklist ticket.

ci-bot: Security review ticket created: SEC-4821.

jordan (Support): Customer A asked for timeframe by tomorrow. Can we give a conservative estimate (6 weeks) while we scope?

maya (PM): I'll communicate 6-week conservative estimate for SSO/SCIM. For Terraform provider, I'll confirm 2–3 week MVP contingent on scope lock.

priya (DevEx): One more suggestion — add a "source:sales/support" tag to help filter volume in backlog and a custom field for "rev impact" to prioritize commercial asks.

alex (Eng): Agreed. Also recommend a rollout plan for SSO: staged deploy to Private customers -> pilot with Customer A -> GA. Acceptance criteria for SSO/SCIM MVP:
- SCIM user provisioning + deprovisioning works end-to-end with audit logs
- Token management integrated with KMS
- Security review passed
- Docs + runbook present

maya (PM): Good. I'll create the product-ticket and link engineering & support artifacts. Anyone volunteering to be owner for Terraform provider?

sophia (Sales): Bets on priya to lead docs + initial provider examples, alex for eng ownership. I can coordinate customer B.

priya (DevEx): I can lead the provider docs and examples. Alex to own the provider implementation.

maya (PM): OK owners noted. I'll update the backlog with labels and push tickets now. Will link Zendesk -> GH issue -> product ticket.

alex (Eng): :thumbsup: Please ping me once the spec ticket exists.

jordan (Support): I'll add the customer's SCIM schema and logs to the Zendesk ticket now.

maya (PM): Thanks team. We'll reconvene after spec drafts. Leaving thread open for any missing constraints. :eyes:
